text:
tara: quick sync from todays bring-up: brought up ceres-40b quant8 (per-layer dynamic) with speculative prefetch lookahead=6 on staging.

liu: perf?

tara: median token latency down ~20% (245 -> 196ms). p95 ~+8ms. token-cost ~-23%.

ben: any signal on quality?

tara: saw intermittent early-repeat + occasional truncated lists on list-generation prompts. not huge but reproducible.

infra-bot: deploy complete: shard s-21, model ceres-40b-q8-spec. logs at /ops/logs/3135792468. flagged: "kv-validate-failure" x7.

liu: sample?

tara: example: "Bulleted list of steps:" -> outputs first two items then repeats item 1 twice, then stops.

ben: sounds like fallback reusing stale kv entries after speculative path fails. quant tweak might sharpen logits so prefetch picks wrong continuation more often.

liu: propose short AB: lookahead=4 vs 6, and lookahead=6 + kv-validate. 300 examples from commons-list, seeds 5/17. metrics: ppl, repeat-rate, list-truncation-rate, median latency.

tara: launching:
```
onboard_run --model ceres-40b-q8 --spec true --lookahead 4 --group A --samples 300 --seed 5
onboard_run --model ceres-40b-q8 --spec true --lookahead 6 --group B --samples 300 --seed 5
onboard_run --model ceres-40b-q8 --spec true --lookahead 6 --kv-validate true --group C --samples 300 --seed 17
```

ben: also dump first-80 logits for 50 examples, and script detection for repeated-bullet patterns.

tara: quick results:
A (lookahead=4): ppl +0.10, repeat-rate 0.6%, truncation 0.3%, latency +5ms
B (lookahead=6): ppl +0.38, repeat-rate 2.4%, truncation 1.1%, latency -18ms
C (lookahead=6+kv-validate): ppl +0.18, repeat-rate 0.4%, truncation 0.1%, latency +12ms

liu: kv-validate is best quality-wise but has nontrivial latency cost. looks like sweet spot is default lookahead=4 for q8 models, and enable kv-validate selectively for list/code routes.

ben: runbook recommendation: canary 5% on Dedicated with lookahead=4, kv-validate opt-in for structured-output routes; alert if repeat-rate>1% or truncation>0.5% for 12h.

tara: will write short ops note + link logs and sample diffs. tagging @eng-oncall.

liu: follow-up experiment: try attention fp16 + rest q8 to see if we can safely raise lookahead to 6.

(thumbsup)
